title: ID0424499-DC/Si-D/CL-[MP / R6 170002002] VLAN Configuration (C1)

additional_info.subject: Note to L3
additional_info.body:
Dear Support,
We have encountered issues when configuring the Open Port through VLAN on the WAN Port to the PLC in the SCB router settings. When loading the configuration, a "Network" error appears.
The example device corresponds to SCB ID hiQWJH.
We need to configure the ELMS, as we are setting up a DLMS system with a Sicam A8000 and using the client's network segment 192.168.1.xxx, according to the attached architecture.
With best regards,
Lodhar Aedo Lobos.

additional_info.subject: Note to L3
additional_info.body:
Suspected Root Cause:
It seems that the ELMS features may not be supported if the chargers are connected via wired WAN.
Problem Description:
For ELMS configuration support, please refer to the customer’s request below for better understanding.
Action Performed (L2):
Verified the PLC settings on the SCB and tried to enable the ELMS, but the same issue occurred.
Charger SW Version:
v6.1.3
Reason for Handover (L3):
Further support.

additional_info.subject: 0424762 - ID0424499-DC/Si-D/CL-[MP / R6 170002002] VLAN Configuration (C1) CRM:00314000167
additional_info.body:
Good evening Lodhar,
I am reaching out from the Expert Services Team in regards of ticket
ID0424762.
The ticket is open for issues in configuring the ELMS on charger
hiQWJH.
From what I understood, on 15.05.2025 you were not able to configure the ELMS on the charger. I believe what has to be done now is to SSH inside the router XF3 and set the port forwarding directly inside the Teltonika settings of the router.
I have first a few questions for you:
Was the communication between charger and ELMS successful at any moment?
Did you verify that the ETH cable is correctly inserted in F01-FA13, as per picture below, and that the ETH connection is established?
From SCB, I that the charger is in error state due to the following error flag:
SafetyRelay_QA26
PLC
SYSTEM
true
ELMS tripped 3SK
As per the ELMS commissioning manual, I see that this error flag can be triggered from the ELMS side. Therefore, I am wondering if the ELMS is communicating with the charger.
If you need support to check together via SSH the settings inside the terminal, please let me know your working hours and we can set an appointment.
Looking forward to hearing your feedback soon.
With kind regards,

additional_info.subject: RE: 0424762 - ID0424499-DC/Si-D/CL-[MP / R6 170002002] VLAN Configuration (C1) CRM:00314000167
additional_info.body:
Dear Support,
The XF3 router is now connected to the internet for the SCB through a client router with the IP address 192.168.1.101/24 via RJ45 cable.
Was communication between the charger and ELMS ever successful? I haven’t been able to test Modbus communication with the charger. The network is currently using the 192.168.1.xxx segment. A VLAN configuration is required to access the charger.
Did you verify that the ETH cable is correctly inserted into F01-FA13, as shown in the image below, and that the ETH connection is established? The cable is connected and is currently being used for SCB access.
We are configuring ELMS to communicate with a Sicam A8000 RTU for the DLMS service. ELMS has already been activated in the SCB PLC configuration. However, when configuring the router through the SCB to enable "Open ports through VLAN on WAN Port to the PLC," it fails and returns an error.
I’m not sure if you could clarify what the PLC IP address is for this service, or what the correct IP segment should be, so I can better understand which IP to assign to the VLAN. Also, please confirm whether this configuration can be done directly on the Teltonika router via the web interface.
I would appreciate your help with these points or with the configuration. I will be on-site all this week from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM (UTC -4 Santiago, Chile).
With best regards,
Lodhar Aedo Lobos.
System Engineer.
